headline: Rebranding the Rose Baker Center, YMCA at Gloucester Crossing update, Cape Ann Transportation Authority report, and building security and access upgrades.
summary: The Council on Aging will discuss rebranding the Rose Baker Center, hear updates from the Gloucester Health Department, YMCA at Gloucester Crossing, and Cape Ann Transportation Authority, and review building, DPW, and IT projects such as security cameras, alarms, and door upgrades.
